thread:
sara_docs: heads up — I'm opening a PR to consolidate the function-calling + structured-output examples. goal: one canonical set of JSON schema examples and language SDK snippets across the docs. will ping reviewers shortly.

alex_m: nice. any breaking changes to the example shapes? trying to avoid churn for integrators. :eyes:

sara_docs: not breaking. mostly cleanup and adding a few explicit fallback parsing examples (parse failures, partial objects). also fixing a couple of dead links.

jamie: I can review the JS SDK snippets. Are we standardizing on the `structured_output` field name for responses?

sara_docs: yes — agreed on `structured_output` as the canonical top-level key for tool outputs. will add a note in the migration guide.

maria: I'll take the python snippets. Pls add a small test harness example showing robust parse handling (e.g., try/except + graceful fallback).

alex_m: this code block looks good for the schema example, want to include it in the doc?

```json
{
  "function": "create_order",
  "input_schema": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "order_id": {"type": "string"},
      "items": {
        "type": "array",
        "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {"sku": {"type": "string"}, "qty": {"type": "integer"}}}
      }
    },
    "required": ["order_id", "items"]
  },
  "output_schema": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "status": {"type": "string"},
      "tracking_id": {"type": ["string", "null"]}
    },
    "required": ["status"]
  }
}
```

sara_docs: yep, that's the one. we'll include a short note about nullable vs missing fields and a tiny snippet about "best-effort parsing" when the model returns extra keys.

jamie: for the JS examples, I'll add a streaming snippet + function-caller integration. want to ensure we show both the SDK helper and the raw HTTP request version.

maria: also flagging a docs-to-code checklist: (1) all examples must run (2) include expected output snippet (3) add unit test pointers (4) fix internal links to examples repo.

sara_docs: good checklist. I'll add that as a PR checklist item and add reviewers: @alex_m, @jamie, @maria.

ci-bot: PR #4521 opened by sara_docs: "docs: consolidate structured-output & function-calling examples" — https://git.internal/repo/pulls/4521 :rocket:

alex_m: I'll review this afternoon. quick ask — can we avoid embedding long raw logs in the doc? maybe link to a gist for long regression logs.

sara_docs: agreed. will move long logs to the examples repo and keep docs focused.

jamie: pinging about link fixes — I found 2 stray links to the old tool-calling guide. I can do a follow-up PR to redirect them to the new consolidated page.

sara_docs: perfect. if you can, mark them in the PR checklist so we don't forget.

maria: should we add a small migration note for Dedicated/Private customers about locked model versions affecting function-calling schema?

sara_docs: yes — short paragraph: "If you pin to older model versions in Dedicated/Private, ensure your schema expectations match the model behavior; prefer server-side validation as a safeguard."

alex_m: LGTM. I'll add a quick perf note about how batching can change timing of streaming function calls (edge-case for connector timeouts).

sara_docs: thanks all. plan: merge after approvals, then backfill a short release note and update the docs changelog. I'll post a follow-up here with the merge status. :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: PR #4521 merged by alex_m — https://git.internal/repo/pulls/4521/merge (1718004948)

jamie: nice! will open the JS examples follow-up for the streaming snippet.

maria: done — I'll add the python test harness example in a separate PR.

sara_docs: closing loop — thanks everyone for fast reviews. if you see anything odd in the live docs after deploy, flag it here. :pray:
